title: 3 Notifications for each email received; constant 'failed to authenticate' error.
creator: lvanwyk83
content:
Firstly, thank you for providing a simple and clean email client - appreciate the efforts!

I recently switched from K9 Mail to Thunderbird on my Android, seems the two are very similar. When setting up Thunderbird, I chose to use the settings from K9. I have one Gmail account that I use these clients for.

I have two issues: 1) I get 3 Notifications for each email received. It seems to me there is a notification for/from Inbox, All Mail and Important. I have scoured the settings to try and disable or get so these is only one notification per email, but it's not clear to me what or where I should change. I also searched the blogs and do not find a similar issue. All emails go in my inbox, I do not have any rules set up. I don't need the Important filter/separator either, don't use it. This issue is for both K9 and TB.

2) I frequently get an 'authentication failed' notification for the Gmail account. It seems to happen almost every time I switch internet connections - e.g. from wifi to mobile data and vice versa or between different wifi networks. Recently I noticed that the issue seems to sort itself out if I close the app an relaunch. Is this normal? I think it is also for both K9 and TB, I have K9 disabled at the moment and still get the notification, but not clear to me which app it's from.

Would appreciate some guidance to sort this out.
